mapper.select: SELECT ug.id, ug.group_id, sg.group_name,g.id AS company_id,g.group_name AS company_name FROM sys_user_group ug LEFT JOIN sys_group sg ON sg.id = ug.group_id LEFT JOIN sys_group g ON sg.parent_id LIKE CONCAT(g.id, '%') AND g.group_level = 1 WHERE ug.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR}
SELECT ug.id, ug.group_id FROM sys_user_group ug WHERE ug.group_id LIKE CONCAT(#{groupId, jdbcType=CHAR}, '%')
SELECT g.group_id FROM sys_user_group g LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON g.user_id = u.id WHERE u.user_no = #{userNo}

SELECT g.id, g.user_id, g.group_id, g.org_id, u.user_no FROM sys_user_group g LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON g.user_id = u.id WHERE u.user_no in
#{item}
